Collaborate

Get involved

This is an early-stage, independent initiative. No studies are running or recruiting yet. Interest is welcome from:

  • Researchers and clinicians working on ADHD, mood and anxiety, autism, sleep, psychiatric classification, imaging, or digital health
  • Adults with ADHD or related conditions interested in advising on study design, or in helping decide how adult attention problems should be named and described
  • Developers who want to help build open-source task and measurement tools
Start a conversation on GitHub

PreviousEvidence review

Not medical advice. This site describes a research approach and summarizes published evidence for general education. It does not diagnose or treat any condition, and nothing here is a reason to start, stop, or change a medicine or supplement. Talk to a qualified clinician about assessment or treatment.

Struggling right now? In the US, call or text 988. In the UK and Ireland, call Samaritans on 116 123. Elsewhere, find a free helpline at findahelpline.com. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.
